items.title: Restore the complete saved practice state
items.userOutcome: A returning dancer resumes the same section, framing, and dancer without repeating setup.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid on-device resume state bypasses repeat calibration while an explicit recalibrate path remains.
Trim, A/B loop, normalized offsets, zoom, personCenter, and solo selection restore before save effects can overwrite them.
Missing or corrupt state follows the existing calibration path.
State remains on-device and usable offline.
Focused tests cover full restoration and the empty-write race.

items.title: Make practice-stage controls accessible and at least 44px
items.userOutcome: Stage controls are identifiable and operable by touch, keyboard, and assistive technology.
acceptanceCriteria: Every icon-only stage control has a stable accessible name and state where applicable.
Every stage target is at least 44x44 CSS pixels in portrait and landscape/desktop.
Focus remains visible and keyboard activation works.
No new top-chrome or video/canvas geometry regression.
Focused regression coverage is added without changing the verifier.
dependencies: TRACE-001 completes or releases TraceTab ownership

items.title: Run the real-phone core journey
items.userOutcome: Trace is evaluated on the actual rehearsal device for setup, distance use, saved return, drilling, orientation, scan responsiveness, and group dancer selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Record phone, OS, browser versus installed PWA, commit, and source clips.
Exercise first-time setup and judge controls/readouts from 8-10 feet.
Rotate orientations and confirm video/canvas landmarks remain aligned.
Run A/B WATCH/DANCE drill and return to the saved section after reload.
Record scan timing/responsiveness and real group-footage identity through crossings.
Attach screenshots/timings and explicit pass/fail observations.
dependencies: reviewable build at a recorded commit
blockedBy: physical phone and human observer required
